Select the first 1000 activity rows for target CHEMBL1075126. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary using tid. Join activities to molecule_dictionary via molregno. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pchembl_value. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
